metadata.title: Getting Started with Digital Preservation: Fixity Pro
metadata.author: ScottishArchivesTV
metadata.shortDescription: In this short video Karyn Williamson, Digikive, will explore using Fixity-Pro to check and maintain your digital collections. Fixity Pro is an integrity checking tool specifically designed for digital preservation, and maintained by an organisation called AVP.
